name: Deflection_Shield
display_fullname: Crey Crey Boss Armored Buff High Deflection Shield
display_help: Dramatically protects an ally from Smashing, Lethal and all Melee attacks for a limited time. Also reduces Toxic damage. You cannot stack multiple Deflection Shields on the same target; however, the shield can be improved by another ally using the same power. Can also be used in conjunction with your Insulation Shield. You cannot use this power on yourself.
display_short_help: Ranged, Ally +DEF(Smash, Lethal, Fire, Cold, Energy, Negative), +Res(Toxic, End Drain)
